scrap.title: Scrap and regrind
scrap.subtitle: Every kilo from the machines is weighed: reused as regrind, or sold for revenue
scrap.stockEmptyBody: Scrap appears here once it is weighed in. Scrap items are marked in the product master.
scrap.entriesEmptyBody: Record rejects, purge and runners per machine and mould with the form above.
scrap.salesNote: Each sale is a GST invoice to a buyer with KYC, made on the sales screen. Link the posted invoice here and the scrap leaves stock once, by the quantity on the invoice. Cash for scrap follows the cash limits in the cash book.
scrap.readOnly: Read-only access: you can see scrap but not record it.
scrap.noRight: You don't have the right to record scrap. Ask Admin.
scrap.weighTitle: Weigh in scrap or reuse regrind
scrap.inNote: Weighed scrap is added to scrap stock of that type at the chosen place.
scrap.reuseNote: Regrind taken back into production leaves scrap stock; the server refuses more than is there.

err.qty: Enter a weight above zero (up to 3 decimals).
err.sale: Choose the invoice and the place.

scrap.how: Shift entry: rejects, purge on colour change and runners, by weight, per machine and mould. Clean runners of one material go back as regrind up to the share the cost sheet allows. The rest is weighed into scrap stock by type, kept apart so each sells at its best rate.
scrap.revenue: Scrap sales reduce the production cost of the month, so cost per piece is net of scrap. The GST rate on scrap and whether TCS applies come from the HSN table and your CA; the ERP never assumes them.
